features.name: AI evaluation harnesses (agent-eval + scripts/eval)
features.rationale: Internal quality gate for AI features: benchmarks agents setting up Storybook and writing stories; ~36k lines outside code/.

features.name: Setup checklist (sidebar widget + settings page)
features.rationale: Onboarding nag with short-lived value per project; its fix rate costs more than it converts (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Shown to every 10.x install; acted on by some.

features.name: Monorepo build, release and CI scripts
features.rationale: Maintainer-only; keeps releases and CI running.

features.name: Docgen harness (cross-framework comparison & perf fixtures)
features.rationale: Internal verification tooling; 10k lines of fixtures and perf scaffolding.

features.name: Agentic review mode
features.rationale: Experimental workflow that has not yet proven demand; 5 issues is little feedback for 4.5k lines (confirmed by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Experimental review mode; few users.

features.name: Svelte CSF (.stories.svelte) compiler
features.rationale: A second story format for one framework, valued by its community and quiet in churn (confirmed by Steve, 2026-10-21).

features.name: Svelte docgen
features.rationale: Provider exists but is unexported; sveltedoc-parser is lightly maintained upstream.
features.reach_rationale: Svelte share of installs; provider unexported.

features.name: Server renderer + server-webpack5 framework
features.rationale: Niche (server-rendered HTML snippets); webpack-only; ~440k downloads/month mostly transitive.

features.name: Measure
features.rationale: Browser devtools do this better; 2 open issues.
features.reach_rationale: Rarely opened; devtools do this better.

features.name: Angular docgen (angular-cm analyzer, Compodoc)
features.rationale: Angular users need it; two generations (Compodoc, angular-cm) coexist during the transition.
features.reach_rationale: Angular share of installs, webpack and Vite together.

features.name: Sandbox templates & generated sandboxes
features.rationale: Maintainer-only; the per-framework smoke-test corpus.

features.name: Module graph service
features.rationale: Feeds change detection and story lookup; still experimental, no direct user surface (confirmed by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Runs alongside the docgen server for file tracking; no direct UI.

features.name: Preact renderer
features.rationale: ~270k downloads/month and a thin wrapper, but a distinct support surface.

features.name: Angular (webpack) framework
features.rationale: 2.2M downloads/month, enterprise-heavy; being superseded by angular-vite.

features.name: Ember framework
features.rationale: 24k downloads/month; webpack-only; no docgen.

features.name: Onboarding (tour guide, confetti, survey)
features.rationale: First-run only; pulls react-joyride and a confetti library into the manager.

features.name: Outline
features.rationale: Debug CSS outlines; trivially replaceable.
features.reach_rationale: Rarely opened.

features.name: Package manager abstraction (npm, yarn 1/2, pnpm, bun)
features.rationale: Needed by init, upgrade, add and automigrations; five proxies to keep in sync.
features.reach_rationale: Exercised by init, upgrade and add; most projects hit one of them each year.

features.name: Next.js (webpack) framework
features.rationale: 10M downloads/month; heaviest dependency list in the repo (38 runtime deps, Babel + SWC).

features.name: Vue 3 docgen (vue-component-meta, vue-docgen-api)
features.rationale: Two extraction back-ends maintained in parallel; 6.7k lines for one framework.
features.reach_rationale: Vue 3 share of installs.

features.name: Web Components (Lit) renderer
features.rationale: Design-system teams value it; ~1M downloads/month.

features.name: React Native Web + Vite framework (+ RN init generators)
features.rationale: 1.4M downloads/month; the init generator for on-device RN is the bulk of the code.

features.name: Angular + Vite framework
features.rationale: Strategic replacement for the webpack Angular path; only 490k downloads so far.

features.name: TanStack Start/Router framework
features.rationale: Strategic bet on a rising React meta-framework; the fix churn is the price of tracking a pre-1.0 upstream (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).

features.name: Version check, What's New, upgrade banner
features.rationale: Marketing/upgrade nudges; low cost.
features.reach_rationale: Version banner in every dev session that is behind.

features.name: Next.js + Vite framework (+ vite-plugin-storybook-nextjs)
features.rationale: 12M downloads/month and growing; the recommended Next.js path.

features.name: Telemetry & project metadata collection
features.rationale: No user value but the maintainers' main signal for prioritisation.
features.reach_rationale: Opt-out; most installs keep it on.

features.name: React + webpack 5 framework (+ preset-react-webpack)
features.rationale: ~10M downloads/month but a legacy path; SWC/Babel compiler addons live outside the repo.

features.name: eslint-plugin-storybook
features.rationale: 35M downloads/month; cheap relative to reach.

features.name: Config loading, presets system, shared Node utilities, public types
features.rationale: Every Storybook run starts here; presets are the extension model.
features.reach_rationale: Every run loads config and presets.

features.name: Pseudo states addon
features.rationale: 4.4M downloads/month; CSS rewriting is brittle across frameworks.

features.name: Webpack 5 builder + core-webpack
features.rationale: 23M downloads/month, declining; still the only path for Next.js-webpack, Angular-webpack and Ember.

features.name: Web Components docgen (custom-elements manifest)
features.rationale: Design-system teams on Lit depend on it; CEM is the ecosystem standard and worth owning (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Web Components share of installs.

features.name: Vitest addon (browser-mode runner, testing widget, coverage)
features.rationale: 22M downloads/month; the strategic replacement for test-runner.

features.name: E2E suites, internal Storybook, benchmarks, test setup
features.rationale: Maintainer-only; regression safety net.

features.name: Portable stories (composeStories)
features.rationale: Reuse of stories in external test runners; superseded for most users by the Vitest addon.
features.reach_rationale: Telemetry-tracked but niche; most story testing moved to the Vitest addon.

features.name: Manager shell (layout, panels, mobile, notifications, shortcuts, settings, manager-api core, router)
features.rationale: The application frame every addon renders into.
features.reach_rationale: Every session.

features.name: SvelteKit framework
features.rationale: 1.2M downloads/month; thin layer over svelte-vite plus $app mocks.

features.name: `storybook upgrade`, automigrations, autoblockers, codemods
features.rationale: Upgrade friction is the main churn risk for the project; 24 open automigration issues.
features.reach_rationale: Most projects upgrade at least once a year; codemod downloads undercount this.

features.name: AST story/config tooling (CsfFile, ConfigFile, story-shape)
features.rationale: Powers indexing, automigrations, save-story and AI tools without executing user code.
features.reach_rationale: Indexing parses every story file on every run.

features.name: Sidebar tree (explorer, rows, sticky headers, statuses, keyboard navigation)
features.rationale: Primary navigation; the largest single UI surface (excluding the 27k-line mock fixture).
features.reach_rationale: Every session.

features.name: Shared UI component library (storybook/internal/components)
features.rationale: Used by the manager and every addon panel; react-aria migration doubles some primitives.
features.reach_rationale: Every panel renders with it.

features.name: Vue 3 renderer
features.rationale: Second-largest framework community.

features.name: Module mocking (sb.mock, vite mocker, Next.js export mocks)
features.rationale: Needed for realistic stories of connected components; Vite-only today.
features.reach_rationale: Vite projects that mock modules; a minority of story authors.

features.name: Docs: autodocs, doc blocks, DocsRenderer
features.rationale: 75M downloads/month; 175 open issues, the most of any label.

features.name: Accessibility addon (axe-core, vision simulator)
features.rationale: 49M downloads/month; integrated with the test widget.

features.name: Component manifests (components/docs manifest generation)
features.rationale: Core technology behind the agent APIs, which are the project's most important bet (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Behind the componentsManifest flag; consumed by agents.

features.name: Save story from controls
features.rationale: Writes CSF back to disk; handy but not core to the loop.
features.reach_rationale: Occasional use when iterating on args.

features.name: Change detection (git diff → changed stories)
features.rationale: Foundation for agent and CI workflows that only touch what changed; on by default where supported (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Needs git plus the docgen server; shipped this year.

features.name: `storybook doctor`
features.rationale: Diagnostics for support; low usage.
features.reach_rationale: Run on request during support.

features.name: Ghost stories (auto-generated stories for untested components)
features.rationale: Experimental; surfaces coverage gaps but generates synthetic args.
features.reach_rationale: Experimental.

features.name: Embed mode (story freezer, resize broadcast, remote iframe embed)
features.rationale: Recent capability for embedding stories elsewhere (insecureRemoteIframeEmbed flag); niche today.
features.reach_rationale: Opt-in flag shipped this year; few known adopters.

features.name: React docgen (react-docgen, react-docgen-typescript, component-meta TS program, JSX source decorator)
features.rationale: Controls and ArgTypes for the biggest audience depend on it; three extraction backends coexist (react-docgen, react-docgen-typescript, component-meta).
features.reach_rationale: React share of installs; nearly all of them show ArgTypes.

features.name: Highlight
features.rationale: Used by a11y and measure; little direct user value.
features.reach_rationale: Mostly indirect via a11y and measure; little direct use.

features.name: Node & client loggers (clack prompts, task output)
features.rationale: Infrastructure; the prompt UI layer adds weight beyond plain logging.
features.reach_rationale: Every CLI run.

features.name: `storybook init` / create-storybook (generators, prompts, scaffolding)
features.rationale: First impression for every new user; 1.7M direct downloads/month.
features.reach_rationale: Every project was initialised; create-storybook downloads undercount npx runs.

features.name: Open-service framework (schema-driven services, sync, query runtime, toolset registry)
features.rationale: Foundation of the agent stack: manifests, toolsets, review and change detection are built on it (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Active wherever the docgen server, MCP or review run; most React/Vue installs.

features.name: Svelte renderer
features.rationale: Healthy community; Svelte 5 runes support is actively demanded.

features.name: Storybook composition (refs)
features.rationale: Key for multi-repo design systems; 28 open issues.
features.reach_rationale: Refs are configured by larger organisations only.

features.name: Sidebar context menu
features.rationale: Hosts per-story actions (tests, review); modest standalone value.
features.reach_rationale: Used for per-story test and review actions by a minority.

features.name: Story docs / code examples service (Code panel)
features.rationale: Part of the agent-facing substrate: code examples for docs and agents (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Behind experimentalCodeExamples.

features.name: Universal store, status store, test-provider store
features.rationale: Cross-environment state sync used by statuses, testing and checklist.
features.reach_rationale: Statuses and stores load in every manager.

features.name: Dev server (polka middleware, statics, host validation, server channel)
features.rationale: The `storybook dev` command.
features.reach_rationale: Every `storybook dev`.

features.name: Interaction testing (storybook/test, instrumenter, interactions panel)
features.rationale: play functions are the testing story; depends on Testing Library and Vitest expect/spy.
features.reach_rationale: play functions are in roughly half of projects.

features.name: Themes addon (component theme switching decorators)
features.rationale: 16M downloads/month; small decorators.

features.name: Manager theming (Emotion)
features.rationale: Brand customisation is common in design-system teams; Emotion is the largest manager runtime dependency.
features.reach_rationale: Dark mode plus custom brand themes.

features.name: Viewport
features.rationale: Responsive checks are a daily task.
features.reach_rationale: Responsive checks are a daily task for most.

features.name: Links addon
features.rationale: 28M downloads/month is template inertia; tiny code.

features.name: Agent toolsets (docs access, stories, test)
features.rationale: The capabilities the agent APIs expose; mission-critical (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Same audience as MCP.

features.name: Preview runtime (Preview, selection, render loop, URL, addons API)
features.rationale: The render loop itself.
features.reach_rationale: The render loop of every preview.

features.name: MDX compilation & CSF plugin
features.rationale: Hand-written docs pages; 41 open mdx issues.
features.reach_rationale: Hand-written MDX pages exist in a large minority of projects.

features.name: MCP server (addon-mcp + @storybook/mcp)
features.rationale: The front door of the agent APIs; mission-critical alongside manifests and skills (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).

features.name: Controls (panel + ArgsTable/control widgets shared with docs)
features.rationale: The interactive heart of Storybook; 84 open issues.
features.reach_rationale: The panel nearly everyone uses.

features.name: CLI entry points, dispatcher, project detection, global settings
features.rationale: Everything reachable from `npx storybook`.
features.reach_rationale: Every install runs the CLI; @storybook/cli downloads measure the legacy package, not usage.

features.name: Sidebar search (fuse.js, downshift)
features.rationale: Daily-use navigation aid; two UI libraries for one widget.
features.reach_rationale: Most users search at least once per session.

features.name: Story indexing (StoryIndexGenerator, index.json, watchers)
features.rationale: The sidebar, docs and tests all start from the index.
features.reach_rationale: Every dev server and build indexes.

features.name: Docgen server, component-meta (TS program) & docs-tools
features.rationale: Foundation of the agent stack and of controls/docs for React, Vue and Angular (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Default-on wherever a provider exists: React, Vue 3 and Angular-Vite installs.

features.name: Tags and sidebar filtering
features.rationale: Tags drive autodocs, test selection and visibility.
features.reach_rationale: Tags are universal, the filter panel is new and used by a minority.

features.name: `storybook tools` CLI, SDK, attach/child-host runtime, instance registry
features.rationale: The second agent transport, as critical as MCP (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Agents that use the CLI rather than MCP.

features.name: Actions
features.rationale: Default event logging; react-inspector dependency.
features.reach_rationale: fn() spies are in every template; most stories log actions.

features.name: HTML renderer
features.rationale: Small and cheap; the fallback for framework-less projects.

features.name: Preact + Vite framework
features.rationale: Thin; 220k downloads/month.

features.name: Open in editor
features.rationale: Convenience; depends on launch-editor.
features.reach_rationale: Dev-mode convenience; needs a detectable editor and a click.

features.name: React renderer
features.rationale: Largest user base by far.

features.name: Toolbars & globals
features.rationale: Theme/locale switching idiom for most teams.
features.reach_rationale: Theme and locale switchers in design-system Storybooks.

features.name: Channels, core events and error catalogues
features.rationale: Manager/preview transport and the structured error system.
features.reach_rationale: Manager/preview transport in every session.

features.name: `storybook add`, postinstall hooks, addon config sync
features.rationale: Addon ecosystem on-ramp.
features.reach_rationale: `storybook add` and postinstall hooks run for about half of projects.

features.name: Agent skills, instructions, Claude/Codex plugins
features.rationale: Mission-critical: the instructions that make the agent APIs usable; as central as manifests (re-scored by Steve, 2026-10-21).
features.reach_rationale: Projects that install the skills or plugins.

features.name: Manager bundler (esbuild) and globals maps
features.rationale: Builds the manager and every addon's manager entry.
features.reach_rationale: Every manager is bundled by it.

features.name: Vite builder
features.rationale: 71M downloads/month; the default builder.

features.name: Story store (args, globals, parameters, decorators, loaders, hooks)
features.rationale: Prepares and composes every story that renders.
features.reach_rationale: Prepares every rendered story.

features.name: Canvas (iframe host, toolbar, zoom, remount, share, addon tools)
features.rationale: Where the story is shown.
features.reach_rationale: Every session.

features.name: Web Components + Vite framework
features.rationale: Thin; 870k downloads/month.

features.name: Component Story Format types & utilities
features.rationale: CSF is the story contract everything else consumes.
features.reach_rationale: Every story is CSF.

features.name: Backgrounds
features.rationale: Small and widely used.
features.reach_rationale: Common for checking components on dark surfaces.

features.name: Vue 3 + Vite framework
features.rationale: 4.3M downloads/month.

features.name: HTML + Vite framework
features.rationale: Thin; 520k downloads/month.

features.name: Svelte + Vite framework
features.rationale: 1.5M downloads/month.

features.name: Static build (`storybook build`)
features.rationale: Publishing and CI both depend on it.
features.reach_rationale: Most projects build for CI or publishing at least occasionally.

features.name: Parser stacks (Babel + oxc)
features.rationale: Foundation for csf-tools; two parser stacks coexist, which is itself a cost signal.
features.reach_rationale: Runs for every indexed file.

features.name: React + Vite framework
features.rationale: The default React path; 62M downloads/month.

groups.name: AI & agent integration
groups.description: MCP server, toolsets, the tools CLI, agent skills, agentic review and the evaluation harness.

groups.name: Manager UI
groups.description: The Storybook shell: layout, sidebar, canvas toolbar, settings, theming and the shared component library.

groups.name: Story model & preview runtime
groups.description: How stories are declared (CSF), parsed, indexed, loaded and rendered inside the preview iframe, including the per-framework renderers.

groups.name: Builders & frameworks
groups.description: Vite and webpack builder integrations and the per-framework packages that glue renderer, builder and app-framework conventions together.

groups.name: Node core: config, server, build
groups.description: Loading .storybook config and presets, the dev server, static builds, the manager bundler and shared Node infrastructure.

groups.name: Docgen & component metadata
groups.description: Extracting props, types and descriptions from components for controls, docs and AI consumers.

groups.name: Essential & bundled addons
groups.description: Addons shipped in core (actions, controls, viewport, docs, ...) and the first-party addon packages.

groups.name: Repository tooling & test infrastructure
groups.description: Not user-facing: build scripts, sandbox templates, e2e suites and the internal Storybook.

groups.name: CLI & lifecycle
groups.description: storybook init/upgrade/add/doctor, automigrations, codemods and the ESLint plugin.

groups.name: Testing
groups.description: Interaction testing, the Vitest addon and story-level test infrastructure.
